Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The penalty summary table on physical pages one hundred twenty-seven and one hundred twenty-eight extracted with its columns run together, so its loss-of-license, fine, jail and interlock cells cannot be matched to rows with confidence; no fact is taken from it (verify NJ-PEN-D-TABLE).
The chapter opener and section contents pages carry only titles and page numbers and are not used.
The first-offense fee lists name many small fund fees by statute; only the headline fine, IDRC hours and fees, jail term and annual surcharge are taught, and the small fund fees are left to the source [A02].
Interlock rules for drivers convicted in a commercial vehicle concern commercial licenses and are noted but not taught to Class D learners [A04].
